name: InvokeAI
description: Local InvokeAI image-generation backend — the preferred primary engine for standard generation, editing, inpainting, and variations. Installs into a dedicated virtualenv under tools/InvokeAI so its pinned torch stack never conflicts with ComfyUI's embedded Python.
docs: Pip install into a dedicated venv. InvokeAI's model downloads (~several GB each) are a separate step inside the Image workspace.
